item.title: MIT Technology Review Investigation Finds Failures in Border Surveillance Towers
item.description:
MIT Technology Review Investigation Finds Failures in Border Surveillance Towers

An investigation by MIT Technology Review has documented that over a thousand people died in areas monitored by U.S. southern border surveillance towers without being reached or apprehended.

🔍 Overview

Over the past 25 years, the US has invested billions of dollars into a “virtual wall” of surveillance towers along the southern border. These towers were intended to:

  • Detect border crossers
  • Apprehend border crossers
  • Save lives

⚙️ Key details

Recent updates to the surveillance infrastructure include the installation of AI-powered towers. These specific towers are designed to spot people automatically; however, the investigation found that some individuals who died were under the watch of these AI-powered systems.

#AI #Surveillance #BorderSecurity #MITTechnologyReview

Source: Roundtables: The Deadly Failures of The Virtual Border Wall

item.title: AI Surveillance Towers Deployed for Border Monitoring in Southern California
item.description:
AI Surveillance Towers Deployed for Border Monitoring in Southern California

The U.S. border in Southern California has seen a proliferation of surveillance towers equipped with artificial intelligence designed to track movements and distinguish border-crossers from animals and other people.

🧩 How it works

Contractors have implemented newer camera systems using AI to monitor the border. Key technical capabilities include:

  • Hardware: Towers such as those made by General Dynamics feature two sets of electro-optical and infrared cameras.
  • Range: Long-range lenses are capable of tracking targets 5 to 7 miles away.
  • Network Integration: These towers are part of a broader network including trail cameras, radar, infrared sensors, drones, blimps, and satellites (as directed by the Trump administration in March 2025).

⚙️ Key details

  • Cost: The overall cost of these AI surveillance systems exceeds one billion dollars.
  • Scale: More than 120 surveillance towers are located along the California border.

💡 Why it matters

An analysis by the Times of San Diego and an investigation by MIT Technology Review have examined the effectiveness of these systems in relation to migrant deaths:

  • Analysis: At least 138 cases in the past four years involved migrants’ remains found within the range of the cameras.
  • Visibility: An MIT Technology Review topographical analysis estimated more than half of these remains were located in spots where a camera would have a clear line of sight.
Individual Date Found Location/Context Tower Proximity/Visibility
Graciela Gómez Hernández September 2025 Otay Mountain Wilderness One mile away from a General Dynamics tower
Marcia Dutra July 2023 Next to a border fence Tower 2,000 feet away; out of sight of the slope
Elvi Vasquez Bortolon February 2024 Ridge near border wall Tower 1,400 feet away; hidden by a ridge
Ramón Montenegro August 2024 Mountains near Dulzura Tower 1,300 feet away; invisible on other side of a hill

#AI #Surveillance #ComputerVision #BorderSecurity

Source: She died at the San Diego border. A surveillance camera was in plain sight

item.title: Antare Launches AI-Powered Physical Security and Video Analysis Platform
item.description:
Antare Launches AI-Powered Physical Security and Video Analysis Platform

UK-based company Antare has introduced an AI-based physical security platform designed to automatically process footage from fixed and body-worn cameras. The system converts recorded video into searchable data by transcribing and indexing events as they are recorded.

🔍 Overview

The Antare Console performs real-time analysis of video and audio streams. By utilizing AI agents, the platform can monitor for specific activities, including physical and verbal assaults, medical events, safety risks, and suspicious behavior. Security teams receive alerts and live video feeds through the Antare App.

🧩 How it works

Users can perform free-text searches on recorded footage to locate specific incidents. The platform also identifies patterns across recorded data, such as identifying theft hotspots, repeat offenders, and recurring incidents across different locations.

⚙️ Key details

Feature Description
Encryption Data is encrypted on devices and in transit
Access Control Role-based access for cloud-stored data
Certifications SOC 2 Type I certified; SOC 2 Type II and ISO 27001 in progress

🚀 Availability

  • Current compatibility: Antare’s two body-worn camera models.
  • Upcoming hardware: Antare Cloud Gateway will connect the platform with existing fixed cameras.
  • Future development: Antare plans to launch a proprietary fixed camera range in early 2027.

#Antare #AI #VideoSecurity #PhysicalSecurity #Surveillance

Source: Antare launches AI platform for video security

item.title: Texas freezes spending on controversial Flock surveillance cameras
item.description:
Texas freezes spending on controversial Flock surveillance cameras

Texas Governor Greg Abbott has frozen state spending on Flock AI surveillance cameras.

🔍 Overview

  • A Texas Tribune investigation revealed the state spent over $30 million on Flock cameras.
  • The bulk of that money was raised by adding a $1 fee to insurance policies, supposedly to help fight catalytic converter theft.

⚖️ Controversy

  • Multiple officers have been placed on leave or criminally charged for misusing Flock systems, at least six incidents in Texas alone.
  • The company faces scrutiny for:
    • Data‑sharing practices.
    • Placement of some cameras near playgrounds.
    • Employees’ access to video feeds.
    • Unsecured video feeds.
    • Attempts to avoid transparency.

🏛️ Political response

  • Gina Hinojosa, the Democratic candidate for governor, criticized Abbott for expanding the use of the cameras in the state.
  • Rep. Keith Self posted on Instagram: “From Flock cameras to kill switches, we will NOT surrender our Fourth Amendment rights to the growing surveillance state.”

📉 Current status

  • In recent months, cities around the country have been canceling their contracts with Flock, including many in Texas.
  • The governor’s freeze on state spending comes just ahead of the Texas Tribune investigation’s publication.

#FlockCameras #Texas #Surveillance #AIethics #Privacy

Source: Texas Governor Abbott blocks funding for more Flock cameras
